youtube.title: Flamingo pink kyun hote hain, jab wo grey paida hote hain? 🦩 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Flamingo jab paida hota hai to pink nahi, grey hota hai. Toh phir uska itna gehra rang aata kahan se hai? Jawab hai uska khana.

Flamingo paani se chhote shrimp aur algae chhaan kar khate hain. Unmein natural pigments hote hain, bilkul waise hi jaise gajar ko orange banate hain. Flamingo ka body unhe todta hai aur rang feathers mein jama kar leta hai. Zoo mein agar sahi khana na mile, to wo dheere-dheere safed pad jaate hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
